scenes.heading: Variables

scenes.heading: async/await
scenes.caption: async and await are syntax for promises. An async function always returns a promise. await pauses that function until a promise settles, without freezing the rest of the program. The code reads top to bottom, which is easier than a chain of callbacks. Errors arrive through try/catch.

scenes.caption: Clean architecture keeps the business rules in the middle, free of frameworks, and puts databases and web handlers at the edges. The point is that you can change the database or the web framework without rewriting the rules.
